map.📚 深度解析：寿险保额需求（收入替代法）: 📚 Deep Dive: Life Cover Need (Income-Replacement Method)

map.给家庭支柱做保额充足性诊断。: Diagnose cover adequacy for the family breadwinner.
map.所需保额 ≈ 30万×ä₁₀@3%(≈8.53) ≈ 256万。即需约 256: Required cover ≈ 300k×ä₁₀@3% (≈8.53) ≈ 2.56M. That is, about 2.56M life cover to cover 10 years of income gap.
map.还该扣已有资产吗？: Should existing assets also be deducted?
map.应减去可用金融资产与已有保单保额。收入替代法给上限，再按净资产校准更稳妥。: Deduct usable financial assets and existing policy cover. The income-replacement method gives an upper bound; calibrate by net assets for a safer figure.
map.收入替代法会高估需求吗？: Does the income-replacement method overstate the need?
map.会。若只按年收入倍数算，忽略已有储蓄、社保与配偶收入，保额易过高。规范做法是需求: Yes. Basing it only on an income multiple ignores savings, social security and spouse income, inflating cover. Properly, need = liabilities + expense gap - existing resources, then cross-check with an income multiple.
